modifiers.after: One owner selects desired dish, other good food, then starvation food across real inventory/drops/shared stores. Immediate choices cannot outrank an available desired dish. Bad classified edibles only at satiety<10, +1 satiety and negative mood subject to existing history limits. Recruit native bad-food blacklist exception only under that threshold; good blacklisted items still denied. No duplicate extraction, native containers/healing retained.

modifiers.before: JEM resident/Jade path only handles Villager; native recruit hunger/morale invisible there.

Native EatGoal serving suppressed only for managed recruits after native decay. Owner-offline town garrisons can eat; no private-chest theft by unassigned NPCs.
